name: LanguageTool
description: Grammar, style, and spell checking in the markdown editor, powered by LanguageTool.
author: David Schonert

languagetool.backend.description: Which server to check against. Local keeps document text on this machine and is the default. Cloud sends document text to LanguageTool and needs a Premium username and access token.

languagetool.localUrl.description: Base URL of your self-hosted LanguageTool HTTP server.

languagetool.cloudUrl.description: Base URL of the LanguageTool cloud service.

languagetool.username.description: Cloud only. The email address on your LanguageTool account. The access token is stored separately and is not kept here.

languagetool.language.description: Language code such as en-US or en-GB, or auto to detect per document.

languagetool.motherTongue.description: Your first language, such as de-DE. Enables false-friend checks. Leave empty to disable.

languagetool.picky.description: Enable additional rules that are useful for formal writing.

languagetool.disabledRules.description: Comma-separated rule IDs to never report, such as DASH_RULE.

languagetool.disabledCategories.description: Comma-separated category IDs to never report, such as PUNCTUATION.

languagetool.triggerMode.description: How the correction card opens: click the underlined text, or hover over it. Takes effect the next time the extension loads.
